name: summary-01
title: Summary 01 - A Set Of Lines And What They Come To
description: A set of line items and their total, as a real table with a row header on every line, an optional subtotal, a required total that is a prop rather than a number the Block derived, a footnote and a slot for the call to action. Three line states map to the shared status tones and each needs a caller's words, because an excluded line is a claim about a contract. Server Component, so the table costs a consumer nothing in client JavaScript.
